threshold_rule.selection: YES when P(YES) > 0.5; NO when P(YES) < 0.5; no selection at exactly 0.5
threshold_rule.hda_rule: highest-probability H/D/A outcome for ALL fixtures, without a threshold
threshold_rule.probability_precision: selection at full precision; p_yes export rounded to 12 decimals

metric_definitions.hda_log_loss: mean negative natural log probability assigned to the actual H/D/A outcome
metric_definitions.hda_brier_score: mean sum of squared errors across H, D and A (lower is better)
metric_definitions.hda_top1_accuracy: share where the highest-probability H/D/A outcome was correct
metric_definitions.goal_mae: mean absolute error across the two team goal expectations
metric_definitions.goal_bias: mean actual-minus-expected goal error per team; positive means underprediction
metric_definitions.total_goals_mae: mean absolute error of expected match-total goals
metric_definitions.market_hit_rate: correct YES or NO picks / selected picks for each market; null if none selected
metric_definitions.market_coverage: selected YES or NO picks / fixtures with market probabilities

market_provenance.elo_method: original frozen lambdas; unbounded independent Poisson
